title: On condition that
titleEn: Using On condition that for a firm requirement

source.file: Sentence Structure 179 -「On condition that…」表示必要條件.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Main clause + on condition that + subject + verb + other information

formulas.formula: Main clause + on condition that + subject + verb + other information
On condition that + subject + verb + other information, + main clause

example: The funds will be released on condition that the results are made public.
exampleZh: 資金將在結果公開的條件下發放。

examples.en: The funds will be released on condition that the results are made public.
examples.zh: 資金將在結果公開的條件下發放。
examples.highlight: The funds will be released on condition that the results are made public.

rules.zh: That 後面必須接完整子句 On condition that 後面通常需要有主語和動詞。 （你可以進入，條件是你出示門票。）
rules.en: That must be followed by a complete clause, normally with a subject and verb: You may enter on condition that you show your ticket, not on condition that your ticket.
examples: You may enter on condition that you show your ticket.
You may enter on condition that your ticket.

rules.zh: 條件可以放在主句之前或之後 條件放在後面時，前面通常不需要逗號： 條件放在句首時，條件子句後面要加逗號：
rules.en: The condition can come before or after the main clause. When it follows the main clause, a comma is normally unnecessary. When it comes first, place a comma after the condition clause.
examples: You may borrow the camera on condition that you handle it carefully.
On condition that you handle it carefully, you may borrow the camera.

rules.zh: 表達將來條件時，條件子句通常使用現在式 即使主句使用 will，on condition that 後面通常使用現在式，而不是 will。
rules.en: For a future condition, normally use the present tense in the condition clause. Even if the main clause uses will, on condition that is normally followed by a present form, not will.
examples: The event will proceed on condition that the weather remains safe.
The event will proceed on condition that the weather will remain safe.

rules.zh: 可以表達否定條件 在條件子句的動詞前加入 not，便可以說明某件事不可以發生。 （你可以使用房間，條件是你不發出任何聲響。）
rules.en: A negative condition is possible. Put not before the verb in the condition clause to state what must not happen: You may use the room on condition that you do not make any noise.
examples: You may use the room on condition that you do not make any noise.

rules.zh: 兩部分的主語可以不同 主句和條件子句不必由同一個人執行。 主句主語：the landlord 條件子句主語：the tenant
rules.en: The two clauses may have different subjects; the same person need not perform both actions. In The landlord will allow a pet on condition that the tenant keeps the flat clean, the main-clause subject is the landlord and the condition-clause subject is the tenant.
examples: The landlord will allow a pet on condition that the tenant keeps the flat clean.

rules.zh: On condition that 比普通 if 更強、更正式 If 可以表達一般條件： On condition that 表示較明確、較嚴格的要求，常用於許可、協議、政策、交易或正式安排： Provided that 和 providing that 與它意思相近；as long as 通常較適合日常會話。 On the condition that 也是正確形式，但本練習統一使用 on condition that。
rules.en: On condition that is stronger and more formal than ordinary if. If can state a general condition, whereas on condition that expresses a clear, strict requirement and is common in permissions, agreements, policies, transactions and formal arrangements. Provided that and providing that have similar meanings; as long as is usually more conversational. On the condition that is also grammatical, but this exercise consistently uses on condition that.
examples: You can come if you are free.
You may use the equipment on condition that you follow the safety rules.

benefits.zh: 清楚表達必要條件 這個句型能讓對方立即明白：相關條件不是普通建議，而是必須遵守的要求。 （禮堂可以使用，條件是緊急出口保持暢通。）
benefits.en: It makes a necessary condition or firm requirement clear. The listener immediately understands that the condition is not merely advice but a requirement that must be met: The hall may be used on condition that the emergency exits remain clear.
examples: The hall may be used on condition that the emergency exits remain clear.

benefits.zh: 適合表達許可和協議 當你准許別人做某事，但同時需要對方遵守規則時，這個句型非常實用。 （你可以借用我的手提電腦，條件是你今晚歸還。）
benefits.en: It is useful for permission and agreements. When allowing someone to do something while requiring compliance with a rule, use a sentence such as You may borrow my laptop on condition that you return it tonight.
examples: You may borrow my laptop on condition that you return it tonight.

benefits.zh: 把安排和條件連接起來 你可以把一項安排和它的必要條件放在同一句內，不需要使用兩句分開說明。
benefits.en: It connects an arrangement and its condition Without the target structure: The company will offer flexible hours. Employees must complete their weekly duties. Using the target structure: The company will offer flexible hours on condition that employees complete their weekly duties.
examples: The company will offer flexible hours. Employees must complete their weekly duties.
The company will offer flexible hours on condition that employees complete their weekly duties.

benefits.zh: 讓正式寫作更加準確 這個句型常見於規則、通知、商業協議、政策、報告和正式電郵，能清楚說明一項安排成立的前 提。
benefits.en: It makes formal writing more precise. The structure is common in rules, notices, business agreements, policies, reports and formal emails, where it clearly states the prerequisite for an arrangement.

benefits.zh: 可以突出重要條件 把 On condition that... 放在句首，可以先讓讀者注意最重要的要求。 （在每名參加者都簽署表格的條件下，活動將會進行。）
benefits.en: It allows you to emphasise an important condition. Placing On condition that ... first makes the reader notice the requirement before the arrangement: On condition that every participant signs the form, the activity will proceed.
examples: On condition that every participant signs the form, the activity will proceed.
